subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should maintainers accept focused source/runner proof to port the Codex lane-release fix and revive the WhatsApp final-error delivery patch, or require live WhatsApp/Codex proof before either remaining slice lands?
rationale: Current source confirms the remaining failure paths, but the linked lane-release PR is conflicting and paused for human review while the prior WhatsApp delivery patch was closed for missing live transport proof.

options.title: Port And Revive With Focused Proof
options.body: Refresh the linked lane-release fix on current main, revive the narrow WhatsApp final-error delivery patch, and accept focused proof plus explicit maintainer risk acceptance if live credentials are unavailable.

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof
options.body: Pause both slices until a redacted live WhatsApp/Codex wedge or replay proof shows fallback delivery and lane release in the production-like path.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Contract Work
options.body: Keep this issue open but resolve the implementation only through the broader durable final fallback contract issue and close replacement branches that are no longer the desired path.

recommendation.title: Port And Revive With Focused Proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked lane-release fix on current main, revive the narrow WhatsApp final-error delivery patch, and accept focused proof plus explicit maintainer risk acceptance if live credentials are unavailable.
